entries.legacy_invariant: review context != decision context; conflicting reviews may coexist
entries.note: Preserve later-evidence horizon and plurality; use current typed evidence plus DLC-SI only when singular action/representation forces contention.
Contest evidence remains distinct from resolution and effect; no request creates authority or reversal.

entries.legacy_invariant: declared disposition != executed effect != observed outcome
entries.note: Resolution can be represented as bounded evidence/coordination; competing legitimate resolutions remain observable.

entries.legacy_invariant: execution report != verified execution != observed outcome
entries.note: Current Action Gate / Outcome-Provenance plus bounded lifecycle surfaces supersede a dedicated mutable execution-status worldview.

entries.legacy_invariant: verification report != verified fact != observed outcome
entries.note: Attestation/conformance evidence is explicit and still does not certify truth, compliance or outcome.
Outcome/Provenance/Successor State is a Stable Core primitive; later evidence must not move the original knowledge cutoff.

entries.legacy_invariant: successor proposal != successor record != canonical successor
entries.note: Current successor-state and compatibility/registry infrastructure separates proposal/evolution from activation and canonicality.
Deterministic receipt identity and attestation are reusable current infrastructure; signature validity still cannot upgrade truth or authority.

entries.legacy_invariant: persistent key continuity != verified identity != authority
entries.note: Current reusable stack does not need browser-local key persistence as a Core primitive; a successor identity/evidence profile must decide whether any reusable continuity claim is still required.
Requires explicit mapping to current personal/evidence architecture without reviving account control as identity proof.

entries.legacy_invariant: authority evidence != verified authority != materialization authority
entries.note: Core has Authority/Responsibility semantics, but cross-system evidence of issuer entitlement/delegation needs an explicit modern successor profile rather than legacy self-issued claims.

entries.legacy_invariant: proposal != approval != authority != materialization != canonicality != truth
entries.note: Current stack has successor, contention and registry pieces but no single policy-relative materialization receipt should be inferred from them.

entries.legacy_invariant: validity != completeness != truth; no scalar maturity score
entries.note: Legacy level numbering is historical roadmap vocabulary, not a current reusable protocol primitive or trust hierarchy.
